items.summary: Greco's candidate statement says he will permanently protect Sunset Dunes, the coastline and the Westside groundwater basin, and reduce Ocean Beach pollution.
items.title: Permanently protect Sunset Dunes and the coastline

citations.quote: I will permanently protect Sunset Dunes, our coastline, the Westside groundwater basin, and reduce Ocean Beach pollution.
citations.locator: Voter Information Pamphlet, Candidate Statements, Board of Supervisors District 4, printed p. 42 (PDF p. 44)

items.summary: Greco's candidate statement supports affordable housing in District 4, including intergenerational artistic housing and cooperative business initiatives.
items.title: Affordable and intergenerational artistic housing

citations.quote: I support affordable housing that keeps families, seniors, artists and workers in District 4, including intergenerational artistic housing and cooperative business initiatives
citations.locator: Voter Information Pamphlet, Candidate Statements, Board of Supervisors District 4, printed p. 42 (PDF p. 44)
